name: Barfae Foods – Cafe & Experience

packages.name: Snacks & Shakes
packages.includes: Per person: 1 snack (Plain/Peri-peri French Fries, Onion or Paneer Pakode, Cheese Balls, Crispy Corn) + 1 sandwich or burger (Veg/Paneer Grilled Sandwich, Veg/Paneer Burger) + 1 shake or mocktail (Mango/Chocolate Shake, Cold Coffee, Virgin Mojito, Blue Lagoon)

packages.name: Kids Birthday Pack
packages.includes: Per child: Masala/Cheese Maggi or Red/White Sauce Pasta + French Fries + Mini Pancakes + 1 ice cream scoop + 1 shake (Mango, Chocolate or Banana)

packages.name: Veg Party Meal
packages.includes: Per person: 2 starters (Paneer Tikka, Mushroom Tikka, Crispy Corn, Cheese Balls, Manchurian) + 1 main (Kadhai Paneer, Butter Paneer Masala, Veg Korma, Mushroom Masala) + Dal Tadka + Jeera Rice + Roti/Laccha Paratha + 1 dessert (Gud Pitthi, Ice Cream, Fruit Cream, Custard) + 1 mocktail

packages.name: Non-Veg Party Meal
packages.includes: Per person: 1 chicken starter (Barbecue Chicken Wings, Crispy Chicken, Chicken 65, Chicken Tikka) + 1 veg starter (Paneer Tikka, Crispy Corn) + Chicken Fried Rice or Noodles + Kadhai Paneer with Roti/Laccha Paratha + 1 dessert + 1 mocktail

packages.name: Fasting (Vrat) Special
packages.includes: Per person: Fasting Meal + Sabudana or Makhana Kheer + Singhara Aata Halwa + Cut Fruits. For Mondays, Navratri and other fasting days.

party_questions: Is it dine-in at the cafe, takeaway, or delivery?

Any drinks preference – shakes, mocktails, lassi, chai/coffee?
Dessert – ice cream, Gud Pitthi, Death By Chocolate, cheesecake? Will you bring your own cake?
